status: Synthetic teaching SOP; not an approved real-world AfyaPlus policy. Owner review required before deployment.

rules.scenario: Book a first visit
rules.guidance: Ask registration to verify the patient record, confirm facility and service with the patient, check an available slot, and send confirmation through the approved channel.

rules.scenario: Move an existing visit
rules.guidance: Verify the patient and booking, confirm the replacement slot before releasing the original, update the booking, and send the revised confirmation.

rules.scenario: Cancel a visit
rules.guidance: Verify the patient and booking, record the cancellation without clinical details, release the slot, and confirm cancellation through the approved channel.

rules.scenario: Handle a missed visit
rules.guidance: Check the booking status, offer available replacement slots without blame, and refer any clinical urgency question to the triage nurse.

rules.scenario: No appointment slots remain
rules.guidance: Offer the approved waiting list with consent or another available date; ask the facility team about alternatives and do not promise an extra slot.

rules.scenario: Two bookings exist for one patient
rules.guidance: Verify both bookings and patient preference before cancelling any duplicate; preserve the intended visit and record the correction.

rules.scenario: Confirmation was not received
rules.guidance: Check the booking status and verified contact channel, resend the confirmation if booked, and avoid creating a second booking.

rules.scenario: A patient arrives late
rules.guidance: Tell reception the arrival time and ask the clinic team whether the slot can still be used; offer rebooking if required without promising acceptance.

rules.scenario: A clinician cancels a clinic
rules.guidance: Ask the scheduling lead for approved alternatives, contact affected patients through verified channels, and record each accepted replacement.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a different facility
rules.guidance: Check availability and service at the requested facility, confirm the choice, and update the appointment only after the replacement is accepted.

rules.scenario: A patient has no smartphone
rules.guidance: Offer assisted booking through reception, verify the record, and provide confirmation through an accessible approved channel.

rules.scenario: A relative wants to change a booking
rules.guidance: Verify the relative is authorized before disclosing or changing the booking; otherwise arrange direct contact with the patient.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a reminder
rules.guidance: Confirm consent and the verified contact channel, enable the approved reminder option, and avoid including sensitive clinical details.

rules.scenario: A patient opts out of reminders
rules.guidance: Record the communication preference and disable optional reminders through the approved process; agree how essential booking information will be shared.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a specific clinician
rules.guidance: Check that clinician's actual availability and offer available alternatives; do not guarantee a named clinician before confirmation.

rules.scenario: A walk-in asks for a routine visit
rules.guidance: Direct the person to reception for registration and available slots; clinical urgency is assessed by the triage nurse.

rules.scenario: The booking portal is unavailable
rules.guidance: Use the approved downtime log with minimum information, alert support, and reconcile entries once service returns to prevent duplicate bookings.

rules.scenario: A slot appears twice in the calendar
rules.guidance: Pause confirmation for the affected slot, ask the scheduling lead to resolve the conflict, and tell the patient when an update will be provided.

rules.scenario: A patient needs language support
rules.guidance: Record the preferred language with consent and ask the facility team to arrange approved interpretation for the appointment.

rules.scenario: A patient needs accessible entry
rules.guidance: Ask about access requirements without requesting a diagnosis and coordinate the available assistance with the facility team before confirming arrangements.

rules.scenario: A patient cannot identify the needed service
rules.guidance: Refer service selection involving symptoms to the triage nurse; reception can explain available administrative booking options.

rules.scenario: A patient asks how long the visit will take
rules.guidance: Share only the facility's confirmed scheduling information and explain that actual waiting time can change; do not invent a duration.

rules.scenario: A patient disputes a cancellation
rules.guidance: Check the audit record, preserve the complaint, and route it to the scheduling lead while helping the patient find an available visit.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a booking receipt
rules.guidance: Verify identity and send the booking confirmation through an approved channel; direct payment receipt requests to billing.

rules.scenario: A waiting-list slot becomes available
rules.guidance: Contact the next eligible person using the approved list order, confirm acceptance, and update the list without promising unconfirmed capacity.

rules.scenario: The triage queue is delayed
rules.guidance: Notify the triage nurse or shift lead, record the time and operational delay, and request an update; reception must not assign clinical priority.

rules.scenario: A person reports immediate danger
rules.guidance: Alert the on-site clinical emergency team immediately or direct a remote person to local emergency services; do not delay escalation for registration or payment.

rules.scenario: A patient asks reception to assess severity
rules.guidance: Explain that clinical priority is assigned by a qualified clinician and connect the patient to the triage nurse without offering a diagnosis.

rules.scenario: The triage nurse does not acknowledge a message
rules.guidance: Use the facility escalation chain to contact the shift lead, document attempts and times, and continue seeking a confirmed clinical handoff.

rules.scenario: A patient leaves before triage
rules.guidance: Notify the triage nurse, record the departure factually, and let the clinical team decide follow-up; do not record a clinical assessment at reception.

rules.scenario: A referral handoff is incomplete
rules.guidance: Contact the sending team for the missing operational handoff information through an approved channel and ask the responsible clinician to review the referral.

rules.scenario: A patient asks to skip the triage queue
rules.guidance: Explain that a clinician determines priority, inform the triage nurse of the request, and do not change clinical order independently.

rules.scenario: A patient's situation changes while waiting
rules.guidance: Notify the triage nurse promptly for reassessment and record the notification time; reception must not interpret symptoms.

rules.scenario: A clinical team requests a patient location
rules.guidance: Verify the requesting staff role and share only the minimum location information through the approved internal channel.

rules.scenario: An escalation has no assigned owner
rules.guidance: Ask the shift lead to assign a responsible clinician or team, record the owner, and obtain acknowledgement of the handoff.

rules.scenario: A shift ends during an open escalation
rules.guidance: Include the unresolved case, contact attempts, and responsible team in a secure handover; obtain acknowledgement from the incoming shift.

rules.scenario: A family member asks for triage details
rules.guidance: Verify authorization before sharing information and refer clinical explanations to the responsible clinician.

rules.scenario: A triage notification was sent to the wrong team
rules.guidance: Notify the correct team through the approved channel, record the correction, and follow the privacy incident process if information was misdirected.

rules.scenario: A patient asks for a diagnosis at the desk
rules.guidance: Explain that reception cannot diagnose and arrange contact with a qualified clinician for assessment.

rules.scenario: A patient asks which medicine to take
rules.guidance: Do not recommend medicines or doses; connect the patient to an authorized clinician or pharmacist for clinical advice.

rules.scenario: A patient asks staff to interpret a test result
rules.guidance: Route the request to the responsible clinician and provide only the verified administrative review status.

rules.scenario: An emergency contact is unreachable
rules.guidance: Inform the responsible clinician or shift lead and document contact attempts; the clinical team decides further action.

rules.scenario: A patient objects to clinical priority order
rules.guidance: Explain that priority is determined by the clinical team, route the concern to the triage nurse, and record the complaint respectfully.

rules.scenario: An incident occurs in the waiting area
rules.guidance: Alert the appropriate clinical or site safety team, record factual operational details, and follow the facility incident reporting process.

rules.scenario: A transfer destination has not confirmed acceptance
rules.guidance: Ask the responsible clinical team to obtain acceptance and a named receiving contact; do not mark the handoff complete without confirmation.

rules.scenario: An escalation ticket is accidentally closed
rules.guidance: Reopen or link a corrective ticket, notify the assigned team, and preserve the audit history until a confirmed resolution is recorded.

rules.scenario: A patient requests an update on escalation
rules.guidance: Verify identity, share only confirmed operational status, and ask the responsible team for an update without promising a clinical outcome.

rules.scenario: A queue dashboard disagrees with the handover
rules.guidance: Ask the shift lead to reconcile the records, preserve the discrepancy, and avoid changing clinical priority based only on the dashboard.

rules.scenario: A staff member requests a private messaging handoff
rules.guidance: Use the approved secure clinical channel instead of a personal account and share only information needed by the receiving team.

rules.scenario: A triage complaint needs follow-up
rules.guidance: Record the operational concern with minimum personal information, send it to the shift lead, and give the patient the approved complaint reference.

rules.scenario: Register a new patient
rules.guidance: Use the approved registration process, verify available identity information privately, search for an existing record, and create a new record only after duplicate checks.

rules.scenario: The patient has no identity document
rules.guidance: Ask the registration lead for the approved alternative verification process; do not invent an identifier or delay an urgent clinical handoff.

rules.scenario: Two records may belong to the same person
rules.guidance: Flag the possible duplicate for authorized records staff, preserve both records, and do not merge them at reception.

rules.scenario: The patient's name is misspelled
rules.guidance: Verify the correction through the approved identity process and refer protected identity-field changes to authorized records staff with an audit trail.

rules.scenario: The patient has changed phone number
rules.guidance: Verify identity before updating contact information, confirm the new channel, and record the change through the approved workflow.

rules.scenario: The patient has changed address
rules.guidance: Verify identity, update only the permitted contact fields, and confirm the correction privately through the approved registration process.

rules.scenario: A child arrives with a caregiver
rules.guidance: Follow the approved guardian verification and consent process and ask the registration lead when authority is unclear.

rules.scenario: A patient wants to use a preferred name
rules.guidance: Record the preferred name in the supported field while preserving verified identity information; ask records staff if the system lacks the field.

rules.scenario: A patient requests deletion of a record
rules.guidance: Route the request to the privacy or records lead for review under the applicable retention process; do not delete records at reception.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a copy of records
rules.guidance: Verify identity, record the request, and route it to the authorized records team using the approved disclosure process.

rules.scenario: A relative requests a patient's address
rules.guidance: Verify authorization and purpose before any disclosure; otherwise decline to share and refer the request to the privacy lead.

rules.scenario: An insurance number is missing
rules.guidance: Record the administrative gap and refer coverage questions to billing; do not invent membership details or promise coverage.

rules.scenario: A patient disputes demographic information
rules.guidance: Check identity privately, record the disputed field, and route protected corrections to records staff while preserving the audit trail.

rules.scenario: A patient does not consent to optional messages
rules.guidance: Record the preference and avoid optional messages; explain the approved channel for essential service communication.

rules.scenario: A shared phone is listed as a contact
rules.guidance: Confirm the patient's communication preferences privately and avoid sending sensitive information to a shared device without appropriate authorization.

rules.scenario: A registration form is incomplete
rules.guidance: Ask only for required missing information and seek the registration lead's guidance on exceptions; clinical urgency goes to the triage nurse.

rules.scenario: A patient cannot read the form
rules.guidance: Offer approved accessible assistance or interpretation, check understanding, and follow the consent process without answering on the patient's behalf.

rules.scenario: A date of birth is uncertain
rules.guidance: Ask the registration lead for the approved handling of uncertain identity information and do not invent an exact date.

rules.scenario: A record contains another person's information
rules.guidance: Stop routine edits, alert the records and privacy leads, and preserve evidence through the approved incident process.

rules.scenario: A patient arrives during registration downtime
rules.guidance: Use the approved secure downtime form with minimum data, notify support, and reconcile records when the system returns.

rules.scenario: A patient requests a different emergency contact
rules.guidance: Verify identity, record the authorized contact change, and confirm permissions for sharing information with that contact.

rules.scenario: A staff member wants to export the patient list
rules.guidance: Require an approved purpose and authorized export process; route the request to records or privacy staff and do not use a personal device.

rules.scenario: A patient asks why a field is collected
rules.guidance: Explain the approved purpose of the field and whether it is required; ask the privacy lead when the purpose is unclear.

rules.scenario: A registration receipt shows an incorrect identifier
rules.guidance: Verify the record, ask authorized records staff to correct the issue, and replace the receipt through the approved process without altering audit history.

rules.scenario: A language preference is missing
rules.guidance: Ask the patient which language they prefer, record it in the approved field, and request interpretation when needed.

rules.scenario: A staff account is locked
rules.guidance: Use the approved help-desk recovery channel, verify staff identity, and request unlock; never share passwords or use another person's account.

rules.scenario: A staff member forgot a password
rules.guidance: Use the approved password reset process after identity verification and never request or transmit the existing password.

rules.scenario: A new employee needs access
rules.guidance: Ask the manager to approve role-based access through the help desk and grant only the permissions required for the job.

rules.scenario: An employee changes roles
rules.guidance: Request manager-approved permission changes, remove unneeded access, and verify the new role through the approved access process.

rules.scenario: An employee leaves the organization
rules.guidance: Notify the authorized access administrator through the offboarding process so accounts and sessions are revoked promptly.

rules.scenario: A staff member lost an authentication device
rules.guidance: Report the loss to the help desk or security team, verify identity, and follow approved factor recovery and session revocation procedures.

rules.scenario: A login code is requested by phone
rules.guidance: Do not share the code; report the request through the security channel and use only the approved sign-in process.

rules.scenario: A colleague asks to borrow an account
rules.guidance: Decline account sharing and direct the colleague to the help desk for their own authorized access.

rules.scenario: A user sees permission denied
rules.guidance: Check the requested task with the manager and ask the help desk to review role permissions; do not bypass access controls.

rules.scenario: A suspicious login alert appears
rules.guidance: Report it to the security team using the approved channel and follow their account containment instructions.

rules.scenario: A staff member receives a suspicious link
rules.guidance: Avoid opening the link or entering credentials and report the message through the approved security channel.

rules.scenario: A workstation is left unlocked
rules.guidance: Secure the workstation using the approved lock action and notify the responsible staff member without browsing patient records.

rules.scenario: A shared workstation changes users
rules.guidance: Sign out fully and have the next staff member sign in with their own account; do not leave a previous session active.

rules.scenario: The system is unavailable for all staff
rules.guidance: Notify the help desk, record the outage reference, and use the approved downtime workflow while protecting patient information.

rules.scenario: A single browser session fails
rules.guidance: Use the approved troubleshooting steps and contact support if the issue persists; do not disable security settings or expose patient data in screenshots.

rules.scenario: Support requests a screenshot
rules.guidance: Remove patient details and credentials before sending a screenshot through the approved support channel.

rules.scenario: A vendor requests remote access
rules.guidance: Require an authorized, time-limited support session approved by the access owner and do not share staff credentials.

rules.scenario: A temporary worker needs access
rules.guidance: Request manager-approved time-limited permissions with an expiry and use an individual account.

rules.scenario: A manager asks for administrator privileges
rules.guidance: Route the request for documented approval and least-privilege review; managerial status alone does not authorize administrator access.

rules.scenario: A staff member wants to install a browser extension
rules.guidance: Ask the IT team to approve the extension before installation on a workstation used for patient information.

rules.scenario: A personal email is proposed for record sharing
rules.guidance: Use the approved secure organizational channel and do not send patient records through personal email.

rules.scenario: A user requests deletion of an audit event
rules.guidance: Preserve the audit event and route any correction request to the authorized security or records team.

rules.scenario: An account remains active after offboarding
rules.guidance: Escalate to the access administrator or security team, record the ticket, and request confirmation that access has been revoked.

rules.scenario: A role gives access to the wrong clinic
rules.guidance: Report the excess access to the help desk, avoid viewing unrelated records, and request correction of the role scope.

rules.scenario: A user asks to disable multifactor authentication
rules.guidance: Use the approved recovery process with identity verification and do not bypass or disable the control informally.
